The afternoon sun beat down mercilessly on the dusty grounds of Abydos High School. Once a prestigious institution, now its grand buildings were mostly buried in the sand, with only five students remaining to defend its honor at one of the branch campuses that was being used as a back-up school.

"Uhe~ Atsui... I feel like I'm going to dry up—" Hoshino mumbled from her sprawled position on the floor, her pink hair splayed out like a halo around her head. "So hot even without moving~" The club president fanned herself lazily with a magazine, her school uniform disheveled in the heat. "Maybe we should just take a nap instead of patrolling..."

Nonomi, who had been organizing the snack basket in the corner, turned with a gentle smile. Her long cream-beige hair swayed softly with the movement, catching the sunlight in a way that made it seem to glow. "Mou, Hoshino-senpai, you can't just sleep all day! We have responsibilities, you know~" Despite her words, there was no scolding in her tone—only a maternal warmth that seemed to emanate from her very being.

The comfortable silence was shattered by the sudden blaring of the school's alarm system. The speakers crackled to life throughout the nearly empty campus.

"Intruder alert! Intruder alert!"

"Tch! It's those Helmet Gang punks again!" Serika jumped up from her desk, already reaching for her weapon. "They never learn, do they?"

Shiroko, who had been quietly cleaning her rifle by the window, simply nodded and stood up, her movements precise and economical. "I spotted them approaching the west gate five minutes ago. Approximately twenty-three of them."

"Everyone, get ready!" Ayane called out, hastily adjusting her glasses as she checked her tablet. "They're spreading out across the campus!"

Hoshino sighed dramatically before rolling onto her feet with surprising grace for someone who had appeared half-asleep moments before. "Uhe~ Just when I was getting comfortable... Well, can't be helped. Foreclosure Task Force, move out!"

Nonomi moved to a large metal case in the corner of the room. Opening it revealed her prized possession—a massive minigun that seemed impossibly heavy for her frame. Yet she lifted it with practiced ease, her gentle smile never faltering as she checked its ammunition.

"Mini No.5 is ready to go!" she announced cheerfully, patting the weapon affectionately. "Don't worry, everyone. I'll provide covering fire!"

The girls rushed out of the clubroom, taking up their predetermined positions across the school grounds. From her vantage point on the rooftop, Nonomi could see the Helmet Gang members—easily identified by their ridiculous headgear—spreading across the campus, carrying spray paint and various tools of vandalism.

"Mou, they're going to make such a mess again!" Nonomi pouted, watching as one of them started defacing a wall. She clicked her tongue in disapproval, her maternal instincts kicking in at the sight of such disrespect. "We just cleaned that last week!"

Through her earpiece, she could hear Hoshino coordinating the others. "Shiroko, take the east side. Serika, cover the main entrance. Ayane, stay in the security room and guide us. Nonomi, are you in position? Uhe~"

"Yes, all set!" Nonomi replied cheerfully, positioning her minigun on its stand. "Just say the word, and I'll give them a warm welcome~☆"

"Let's show these guys who they're messing with," Hoshino declared with uncharacteristic seriousness before immediately reverting to her laid-back tone. "Uhe~ Try not to break too many windows this time, okay? Our budget is tight enough as it is..."

"Roger that~♪" Nonomi giggled, her fingers tensing on the trigger.

The first shots came from Shiroko, her precise rifle fire taking out the spray cans in the vandals' hands. The Helmet Gang members scattered in confusion, some taking cover while others pulled out weapons of their own.

"They're armed this time!" Serika's voice crackled through the comms. "These idiots are getting bolder!"

"Nonomi, suppressive fire on the west courtyard!" Hoshino commanded.

"Nonomi~ikima~su~♣" Nonomi called out her battle cry, her sweet voice contrasting sharply with the thunderous roar of her minigun as it sprayed a hail of bullets across the courtyard. The Helmet Gang members dived for cover, their plans of vandalism forgotten in the face of such overwhelming firepower.

Despite the intensity of the moment, Nonomi maintained her gentle expression, guiding her bullets with surprising precision to avoid any serious injuries—just enough to scare them off. The minigun's massive recoil should have been impossible for someone of her stature to control, but she handled it with the same ease as she might pour tea.

"Uwah~ They're retreating already!" she observed with a hint of disappointment. "And I was just getting warmed up!"

From below, she could see Hoshino lazily waving her massive shield, corralling the fleeing gang members toward the gate. "Uhe~ That's right, get going! And tell your friends that Abydos isn't easy pickings!"

As the last of the Helmet Gang scurried away, Nonomi carefully set down her minigun and stretched her arms above her head, her generous chest straining against her uniform. She smiled satisfaction, watching her friends regroup in the courtyard below.

"Oi, Nonomi!" Serika called up, hands on her hips. "Did you have to use so many bullets? Do you know how much those cost?!"

Nonomi leaned over the railing, her hair cascading down like a waterfall of cream-colored silk. "Ara ara~ Don't worry about it, Serika-chan! I have plenty more at home~☆"

"That's not the point!" Serika grumbled, though there was no real anger in her voice—they had all long since grown accustomed to Nonomi's casual attitude toward expenses.

As Nonomi made her way down to join the others, she noticed a figure approaching from the school gates—a young man with slightly disheveled black hair, looking somewhat lost amid the aftermath of the skirmish.

"Oh! Is that the new Sensei from Schale?" Ayane adjusted her glasses, consulting her tablet for confirmation. "The hearsay was true—Maybe we got a reply to the mail we sent to Schale!"

Hoshino yawned, stretching her arms lazily. "Uhe~ Perfect timing. He gets to see us in action on his first day."

Nonomi's eyes lit up, and a warm smile spread across her face. Something about the new arrival sparked an immediate interest in her. He looked a bit overwhelmed, perhaps even a little lonely—awakening her natural maternal instincts. Without waiting for the others, she bounded forward, her minigun temporarily forgotten as she approached the newcomer with genuine enthusiasm.

"Un, un~♪ Welcome, Sensei!" she called out, waving energetically. "I'm Izayoi Nonomi from the Foreclosure Task Force! You came at such an exciting time~☆" Her green eyes sparkled with warmth as she stopped in front of him, clasping her hands together in delight. "We've been waiting for you to arrive!"

She took in his appearance—he seemed younger than she had expected, with a certain vulnerability in his expression that made her heart swell with an inexplicable desire to care for him. The way he seemed slightly out of place, a bit uncertain—it was absolutely endearing.

"Don't worry about the commotion! This happens all the time," she reassured him, reaching out instinctively to brush some dust from his shoulder, the maternal gesture coming naturally to her. "Have you eaten lunch yet? I always pack extra if you're hungry! Oh, and I know all the best spots around campus—I'd be happy to show you around!"

Behind her, she could hear Serika murmuring something about Nonomi "already at it again," but she paid no mind. There was something about this new Sensei that felt special—like they were going to become very close, very quickly.

"I'm so excited to work with you, Sensei!" Nonomi beamed, her smile radiant enough to rival the desert sun above them. "With your help, I just know we'll save Abydos together~♥"
